item.title: Transport v2.5.3.57
item.description:
Product: Transport v2.5.3.57
Company: Levylab
Release Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 07:07:40 -0400
Packager: Patrick Irvin

Description: VIs for scripting and performing transport measurments.

[Control Experiment]
- Control Experiment.vi
- provides a uniform way to record information about your sample & device
- record how the lockin is connected to the device
- configure the Krohn Hite amplifier
- set the base path for saving data
- configure peripheral instruments
- APIs for recording sample data, instrument status

[Transport]
Basic transport measurments:
- Lockin vs time (Lockin_time.vi)
- Lockin Sweep Mode (Lockin_sweep.vi)

[Transport Server]
Server used for scripting and performing asynchronous transport measurments.


Release Notes: [2.5.3]

Fixes
#169: The Transport Server now reports "running" while an experiment runs. The 2.5.2.56 notes listed this fix, but it was not in that build: the status read "idle" during a run, and a second startTransport could launch a second experiment instead of being refused with "Experiment already running".
- The startTransport button in the Transport Server UI now prepares a run the same way the startTransport command does. It selects the experiment VI, writes the experiment folder and dependencies, and clears any earlier stop. In 2.5.2.56 the button skipped these steps, so a run started after a stop could end immediately.

Preview
#163: Configure Experiment no longer loses the configured instruments.
- An instrument whose class can't be found stays in its list as "<name> (not installed)" instead of being cleared.
- Closing the Configure dialog with the window X no longer changes the instrument set.
- If any instruments can't be found when you click OK, a message lists them, and the saved configuration is kept.
- A missing or unreadable Control Experiment.json is reported at startup, and no empty configuration is written over it.
- Instrument classes with similar names (for example Instrument.Lockin and Instrument.LockinAPI) are no longer mixed up.

item.title: Multichannel Lockin v3.6.2.82
item.description:
Product: Multichannel Lockin v3.6.2.82
Company: LevyLab
Release Date: Wed, 23 Sep 2026 12:58:51 -0400
Packager: Patrick Irvin

Description: Multichannel Lockin for National Instruments' Dynamic Signal Acquisition hardware (4431, 4461, 4462).
- This version is configured to handle multiple cards for simultaneous, synchronized AI/AO.
- The analog outputs can be configured to output sine, square, sawtooth, or triangle functions with (swept) DC offsets.
- Each of the analog inputs can be demodulated at multiple frequencies.

Release Notes: # Multichannel Lockin 3.6.2

## Fixes

- **#167** 3.6.1 could not start acquisition: every start failed with DAQmx error -200547. The AO output buffer is now set to two blocks before the first write, so the two-block lead introduced in 3.6.1 works as intended. Do not use 3.6.1.81.
- DAQmx read and write timeouts cut from 10 s to 5 s, so a stalled acquisition is detected and recovered sooner

No API or wire-protocol changes.

## Known issues

- Sweeps started from Transport 2.5.1.55 and earlier run with default settings: they send the old sweep field names, which this version ignores. Rebuild Transport against this package to fix.

## Testing

- Confirmed on hardware: the AO buffer is two blocks (20480 samples per task) and the tasks start without error.
- Because 3.6.1 never acquired, its changes (#160 underflow rate and reference pairing, #165 output gain) have still not run on hardware.
